content:
Sophia: Quick check — prepping quant rollout for mpt-30b-rlhf-v2. Weights uploaded to s3://rw-models/mpt-30b/v2/weights.tar.gz. Can someone confirm checksum + manifest? Planning AWQ baseline then GPTQ fallback.

Alex: Confirmed. Manifest at s3://rw-models/mpt-30b/v2/manifest.json. sha256: 3f7a9c2b9e6d4a1f8b2c9d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3. No missing files seen from my side.

Alex: ```
{
  "weights": ["stage0.bin","stage1.bin","stage2.bin"],
  "manifest_sha256": "3f7a9c2b9e6d4a1f8b2c9d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3"
}
```

Maya: Tokenizer note: we see mismatched byte counts on tokenizer_v2.json when truncating long system prompts. Some examples tokenize "<|endoftext|>" as two tokens vs one. Recommend pinning tokenizer to tokenizer_v1.8 in serving config to avoid drift during canary.

Liam: Calibration data uploaded: s3://rw-calib/mpt30b/v2/calib-2026-03.tar (8.6GB). Contains ~50k examples (mix of chat/system/user). Ran initial AKL pass and cached KV-length distribution.

Ravi: Quick bench (p40x4): FP32 baseline ppl=12.4, AWQ-4bit ppl=13.1 (+5.6%), GPTQ-4bit ppl=12.8 (+3.2%). Instruction-following eval accuracy delta: AWQ -0.9%, GPTQ -0.4%. FP8 (experimental) ppl=12.6, accuracy -0.6% but notably higher memory usage on our runner.

Sophia: Thanks. Proposed rollout: default route AWQ with GPTQ fallback when mean perplexity increase >1.5% OR accuracy drop >1.0% over a 1h window. Canary steps: 5% -> 20% -> 50% (30m between steps). Any objections?

Maya: Agree to rollout but insist on tokenizer pin (tokenizer_v1.8). Also add alert for tokenization mismatches: trigger if >0.3% requests have different token counts vs baseline.

Alex: I'll add a checksum+manifest validation step to onboarding script. Serving config snippet I'll add to the PR: 
```
serving:
  model_path: s3://rw-models/mpt-30b/v2/
  tokenizer: tokenizer_v1.8
  quant_profiles:
    awq: { bits: 4, group: 128 }
    gptq: { bits: 4, group: 128 }
  routing:
    default: awq
    fallback: gptq
canary:
  steps: [5,20,50]
  interval_minutes: 30
  rollback_thresholds:
    ppl_pct_increase: 1.5
    accuracy_drop_pct: 1.0
```

Liam: Monitoring hooks I'll add: per-token latency, per-request avg ppl, rolling accuracy on eval set run every 10 minutes during canary. Also add a daily full-eval job. Will wire alerts to #eng-ml and ops.

Ravi: Approving AWQ canary with those guards. :thumbsup:

Maya: Approving tokenizer pin + rollout plan. :thumbsup:

Sophia: Great — Alex, can you open the PR for serving config + manifest checksum and tag ops for canary readiness? @deploy-bot, please schedule canary after PR merge.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for awq-mpt-30b-v2 at 2026-03-12T15:20:00Z (5% traffic).

Alex: Will open PR in ~15m, adding unit tests for checksum step and a small tokenization regression test.

Sophia: Closing loop: canary auto-switches to GPTQ and alerts if regression >1% in the monitoring window. Thanks everyone, will follow up with PR link and canary playbook.
